name: io.github.alyiox/mcp-clickhousex
title: ClickHouse
description: Read-only MCP server for ClickHouse metadata, parameterized queries, and plan analysis.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CLICKHOUSE_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Optional shortcut DSN for the default profile, for example http://user:password@host:8123/database. For multiple profiles, use ~/.config/mcp-clickhousex/config.json or MCP_CLICKHOUSE_PROFILES_<NAME>_DSN.
